split.rule: Put the empty board in the test group so the original player visits at least one test position. For every other board, use the first of its eight rotations and reflections in cell-by-cell order with O before empty before X. Write the cells as O, dot and X. Prefix the salt (the fixed text above) and a colon. Read the first four SHA-256 bytes as an integer with the most significant byte first and take its remainder upon division by 100. Assign 0 to 64 to training, 65 to 79 to validation and 80 to 99 to test. Retain the move labels for each orientation.
